svg.aria-label: Day 5 hero: an eco-lodge on a rainforest coast with a turtle in the bay. Four students sit at a round table with a planning board: Goals, Plan, Progress, Challenges. A laptop shows a prompt growing from version 1 to 3 beside a friendly AI robot. Speech bubbles say “Building on your idea” and “How about we combine them?” over three option cards, and a gold STAR shines above.
